root_cause: When the 'Show all 4 results' button (#more) is activated, it removes itself from the DOM while it is focused, causing focus to leave the dialog and breaking the :focus-within assertion.
repair_strategy: Before removing the #more button, move focus to another focusable element inside the dialog (the close button) so that keyboard focus remains trapped within the results dialog.
expected_accessibility_effect: Keyboard focus remains inside the results dialog after activating a control that removes itself, ensuring that subsequent tab navigation stays within the trapped dialog.
functional_risks: Focus shifts to the close button instead of staying on the activated button (which is removed). This is acceptable because the button no longer exists and focus remains within the dialog.
verification_requirements: After clicking #more, the #count element text updates to '4 of 4 results'.
The #more button is removed from the DOM.
The #results element has focus within (i.e., :focus-within matches).
Tab navigation continues to cycle within the dialog elements.
